definition: things people do outside for fun, such as hiking or camping
example: BC is famous for outdoor activities like skiing, kayaking and hiking.

definition: to take a long walk in nature for pleasure
vi: đi bộ đường dài (trên đường mòn, núi rừng)
example: We like to go hiking on the North Shore trails on summer weekends.
synonyms: go for a walk in nature

definition: to reserve a place to camp in advance
example: You have to book a campsite months ahead for long weekends in July.

definition: a protected natural area managed by a province
example: Some busy provincial parks require a free day-use pass in summer.

definition: a path through countryside, forests or mountains
example: The trail was closed after heavy rain caused a small landslide.

definition: a paid arrangement that lets you use a gym
example: I cancelled my gym membership because I prefer running outside.
collocations: sign up for a gym membership

definition: an organized exercise session led by an instructor
vi: lớp thể dục, lớp tập thể hình
example: The rec centre offers a lunchtime fitness class for office workers.

definition: money paid to enter a place such as a museum or event
example: The admission fee is $25 for adults, and children under five get in free.

definition: suitable for or welcoming to families with children
vi: phù hợp cho gia đình (có trẻ em)
example: The festival is family-friendly, with face painting and free activities for kids.

definition: time when you are not working and can do what you like
example: In my spare time, I like to fish at the pier in White Rock.

definition: to relax after a period of work or stress
example: After a long week at the warehouse, I unwind by walking along the seawall.

definition: to keep moving and exercising regularly
example: Joining a walking group helps many seniors stay active in winter.

definition: games played by groups, such as hockey or soccer
vi: các môn thể thao đồng đội
example: Team sports teach children how to cooperate and deal with losing.

definition: a new place that makes you feel refreshed
vi: sự thay đổi không khí, đổi gió
example: We drove to Whistler for the weekend because we needed a change of scenery.

definition: to go outside, often to feel better
vi: ra ngoài hít thở không khí trong lành
example: Let's take a short walk at lunch to get some fresh air.
collocations: go out to get some fresh air
need to get some fresh air

definition: to start doing a new hobby or activity
vi: bắt đầu (một sở thích, hoạt động mới)
example: I decided to take up pickleball after my doctor told me to exercise more.

definition: easy enough for people who are new to an activity
vi: dễ cho người mới bắt đầu
example: The Saturday yoga session is beginner-friendly, so no experience is needed.

definition: the last date you can sign up for something
example: The registration deadline for spring swimming lessons is March 1.

definition: with no tickets or items left to buy
example: The Canucks game was sold out, so we watched it at a friend's place.

definition: a short trip that you finish in one day
example: Harrison Hot Springs is a perfect day trip from Vancouver.

definition: if the weather is good enough
example: The outdoor movie night will take place on Friday, weather permitting.
collocations: the event will go ahead, weather permitting

definition: whatever the weather is like
example: The farmers' market runs every Saturday, rain or shine.

definition: having beautiful natural views
vi: có cảnh đẹp, phong cảnh đẹp
example: The Sea-to-Sky Highway is one of the most scenic drives in Canada.

definition: full of people
example: The beach gets so crowded on long weekends that it's hard to find parking.

definition: to be very interested in or enthusiastic about something (informal)
example: My kids seem to be into rock climbing these days, so we go to the climbing gym weekly.

definition: an area where people can put up tents or park camping vehicles, usually with basic facilities
example: The campground by the lake has flush toilets, fire pits and a small playground.

definition: a person whose job is to watch swimmers and help anyone who gets into danger in the water
vi: nhân viên cứu hộ (bể bơi, bãi biển)
example: Children under eight must be with an adult, even when a lifeguard is on duty.

definition: classes in which people learn how to swim or improve their swimming
example: We signed our daughter up for swimming lessons at the rec centre this fall.

definition: a place in the mountains with ski runs, lifts and places to stay or eat
example: The ski resort was so busy over the holidays that the parking lot filled up by 9 a.m.

definition: to travel on water in a small, narrow boat that you move with a paddle
example: On calm summer evenings, we like to go kayaking in Deep Cove.

definition: to do physical exercise to stay fit and healthy
example: I try to work out three times a week at the gym near my office.

definition: a popular paddle sport similar to tennis, played on a smaller court with a plastic ball
vi: môn pickleball (thể thao dùng vợt, giống tennis)
example: The neighbours are complaining about the noise from the new pickleball courts in the park.

definition: to do gentle exercises to prepare your body before a sport or workout
example: The coach always makes us warm up for ten minutes before the game starts.

definition: to become physically fit and healthy through exercise
vi: lấy lại vóc dáng, rèn luyện sức khỏe
example: I joined a running club because I wanted to get in shape before summer.

definition: the equipment you need for camping, such as a tent, sleeping bag and stove
example: Instead of buying new camping gear, we borrowed a tent and stove from a friend.

definition: to go skiing or snowboarding (informal)
example: As soon as the first snow arrives, my coworkers can't wait to hit the slopes.

definition: the place where a trail begins, often with parking and a map
example: The parking lot at the trailhead fills up quickly on sunny weekends, so arrive early.

definition: an official rule that people must not light campfires, usually because of high fire risk
example: Because of the hot, dry weather, a campfire ban is in effect in most of the Interior.
collocations: a campfire ban is in effect

definition: to leave a natural area exactly as you found it, taking all your garbage with you
vi: không để lại dấu vết (mang rác về, giữ nguyên thiên nhiên)
example: Please leave no trace by packing out all your garbage, including food scraps.
synonyms: pack it in, pack it out

definition: a strong pepper spray that hikers carry to protect themselves from a bear attack
example: Always carry bear spray on the trail and keep it where you can reach it quickly.

definition: a part of a park where dogs are allowed to run without a leash
vi: khu vực cho chó chạy tự do (không cần dây xích)
example: Some parents want the off-leash area moved farther away from the playground.

definition: a sports competition with many players or teams, in which the winners play each other until one is left
example: My son's soccer team is playing in a weekend tournament in Kamloops.

definition: a person who watches an event, especially a sports event
example: Thousands of spectators lined the streets to watch the parade.

definition: to shout encouragement to a person or team taking part in a competition
example: Our whole family went to the finish line to cheer on my sister in her first half marathon.

definition: to compete for a place on a team or a part in a performance
example: My daughter is nervous because she's going to try out for the school basketball team.

definition: with you accepting responsibility if you are hurt or lose something
vi: tự chịu rủi ro, tự chịu trách nhiệm
example: The sign at the lake reads: "No lifeguard on duty. Swim at your own risk."

definition: the current state of a trail, such as mud, snow, fallen trees or closures
example: Check the trail conditions online before you go, because there may still be snow at higher elevations.

definition: how good someone is at an activity
vi: trình độ, mức độ kỹ năng
example: The climbing gym offers classes for every skill level, from complete beginners to advanced climbers.

definition: to do gentle exercise or stretching after a hard workout so your body can relax
vi: thả lỏng, hồi phục sau tập
example: After the run, we walk for five minutes to cool down and then stretch.

definition: a walk in nature led by an experienced guide who explains the area
vi: chuyến đi bộ đường dài có hướng dẫn viên
example: The park offers a free guided hike on Sunday mornings to learn about local plants and birds.

definition: a public show of fireworks, often to celebrate a holiday or event
example: We brought blankets to the beach early to get a good spot for the fireworks display.

definition: the service of borrowing sports or outdoor equipment for a fee
vi: dịch vụ cho thuê dụng cụ
example: If you don't own skis, equipment rental is available at the bottom of the gondola.

definition: a large natural area that has not been developed or changed by people
example: Before heading into the wilderness, tell someone your route and when you plan to return.

definition: a sports league for people who play for fun rather than to compete seriously
vi: giải đấu nghiệp dư, giải phong trào
example: I joined a recreational league for adults, so the games are friendly and nobody takes them too seriously.

definition: the activity of going out on a boat to see whales in the ocean
example: Our visitors from Vietnam loved the whale watching tour out of Victoria.

definition: a short trip away from home over a weekend, usually for relaxation
example: For our anniversary, we planned a weekend getaway to a cabin in the Okanagan.

definition: remote areas far from roads and towns, often reached only on foot
vi: vùng núi rừng hẻo lánh (xa đường sá)
example: Avalanche training is strongly recommended for anyone planning to ski in the backcountry.

definition: a part of a park for visitors who come for the day, with picnic tables and toilets but no overnight camping
vi: khu vực dùng trong ngày (không ngủ qua đêm)
example: The day-use area closes at dusk, so we packed up our picnic before sunset.

definition: very enthusiastic about a hobby or activity and doing it often
example: My manager is an avid cyclist who rides to work even in the rain.

definition: a sudden feeling of excitement caused by doing something dangerous or thrilling
vi: cảm giác phấn khích tột độ
example: Ziplining over the canyon gave me a huge adrenaline rush.

definition: extremely beautiful or impressive
vi: đẹp ngoạn mục, đẹp đến nghẹt thở
example: The view from the top of the Chief is absolutely breathtaking on a clear day.

definition: to go somewhere to escape from the stress of everyday life
vi: thoát khỏi mọi bộn bề, xả hơi
example: We rented a cottage on Salt Spring Island to get away from it all for a few days.
collocations: a chance to get away from it all
need to get away from it all
the perfect place to get away from it all

definition: to rest and relax so that you have energy again
vi: nạp lại năng lượng, nghỉ ngơi lấy sức
example: A quiet weekend at the lake is the best way for me to recharge my batteries.
collocations: a chance to recharge your batteries

definition: an activity that you do for pleasure in your free time
example: Fishing off the pier is a favourite pastime for many retirees in our town.

definition: to do something at a steady, controlled speed so that you do not get too tired before you finish
vi: giữ sức, điều chỉnh tốc độ cho đều
example: The hike to the lake takes about six hours, so pace yourself and take short breaks.
collocations: pace yourself on a long hike

definition: the total vertical distance you climb on a trail from start to finish
vi: độ cao leo lên (tổng độ chênh độ cao)
example: The trail is short, but the elevation gain makes it much harder than it looks.

definition: a large amount of snow that suddenly slides down a mountain
example: Officials warned backcountry skiers that the avalanche risk is high after the heavy snowfall.

definition: to sign a form saying you understand the risks of an activity and will not take legal action if you are hurt
vi: ký giấy miễn trừ trách nhiệm
example: Everyone must sign a waiver before they can try the climbing wall.
collocations: be asked to sign a waiver

definition: with the largest number of people that a place or event can hold
example: The pool was at full capacity by noon, so staff stopped letting new swimmers in.

definition: the best result a person has ever achieved in a sport
vi: thành tích cá nhân tốt nhất
example: She set a new personal best in the 10K run along the seawall.

definition: to become very interested in an activity and want to do it all the time (informal)
vi: bị nghiện, mê mẩn (hoạt động gì đó)
example: Be careful — once you try bouldering, it's easy to get hooked on it.

definition: a list of things you want to do or see before you die
vi: danh sách những điều muốn làm trong đời
example: Seeing the northern lights in the Yukon has been on my bucket list for years.

definition: in a place that is far from where most people go
vi: ít người biết, xa khu đông đúc
example: We prefer campsites off the beaten path, where it's quiet and there are fewer crowds.
collocations: a little off the beaten path

definition: needing a lot of physical effort
vi: vất vả, đòi hỏi nỗ lực lớn
example: Avoid strenuous outdoor activity when the air quality is poor because of wildfire smoke.

definition: to live in simple, uncomfortable conditions for a short time, especially outdoors
vi: sống kham khổ, chịu cực (khi cắm trại)
example: We decided to rough it this year and camp without power or running water.

definition: to put as much effort, money or energy as possible into something
vi: dốc hết sức, làm hết mình
example: Our neighbourhood went all out for the summer block party, with live music and a bouncy castle.
collocations: go all out for an event

definition: very pretty, especially in an old-fashioned or natural way, like a painting
example: We stopped for lunch in a picturesque little town on the shore of Kootenay Lake.
